items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...don't you know Lewis? ... The clarinet player, George Lewis, I think you told me before. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, she's Barkay's brother, George Barkay.

ctx.x: Yeah, I believe that was Lewis, yes.
Yeah, I believe it was. I had his picture, but I don't know.
